title: Getting Started with the OpenAI-Compatible API
excerpt: Learn how to connect your favorite tools and libraries to our OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

content.p: Because thousands of tools already speak the OpenAI protocol, you can plug them in without writing any special integration code. Same JSON structure, same authentication header, same streaming events.

content.caption: One endpoint, every tool that speaks the OpenAI protocol

content.p: The fastest way to test your token is a single curl request:
The official openai Python library works out of the box. Just point base_url to our endpoint and set your API key.

content.h: What about LangChain, and other frameworks? 🧩

content.p: All major frameworks let you configure a custom base URL and API key. Look for the base_url option and set it to our endpoint. It really is that simple.

faq.a: Yes. Requests, responses and streaming events match the OpenAI protocol, so tools work without modification.
Any library that lets you set a base URL: openai-python, openai-node, LangChain, LiteLLM, Open WebUI and more.

faq.q: Do I need a special API key format?
faq.a: No. A normal Bearer token created in the panel works with every SDK.

faq.q: What happens if I send a wrong model name?
faq.a: You get a model_not_found error that lists the models available on your account.
